Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000063908-26-000035, filed February 24, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-145548, filed April 7, 2026), read on EDGAR. LEADER: Ray Kroc is deceased; the 2025 proxy calls him 'Our founder', so relation is 'founder' (data.js shows the role 'Former CEO'). The 2026 proxy and FY2025 10-K do not mention him, so the leader source stays the 2025 proxy's sentence; neither discloses a Kroc estate, family, foundation or trust holding, so family is null. HOLDERS: the proxy heads its table 'beneficial owners of more than 5% of our common stock outstanding as of December 31, 2025'; Vanguard's and State Street's footnotes give holdings as of December 31, 2025, but BlackRock's still rests on a 13G/A reporting holdings at December 31, 2023, which is stale. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line ($2,056 million); the equity statement shows $2,016 million of treasury stock purchases. GEOGRAPHY: McDonald's reports revenue by its three segments; International Operated Markets covers markets such as Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Spain and the U.K., and the third segment combines developmental-licensee markets (including China and Japan) with corporate activities. Intercompany revenues are eliminated.
